summary.text: Miranda Lopez is the Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community organizer who has worked in Arizona local and state politics for eight years, including as executive director of the Pima County Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Lopez earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona in 2018 and a graduate degree from the University of Arizona in 2025, and her Ballotpedia profile lists her profession as advocacy.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was also the Southern Regional Director for the Arizona Students' Association and served as local treasurer for United Campus Workers in 2025 while completing a master's degree in public administration.

Lopez said her campaign priorities are fully funding public education instead of universal vouchers, affordable housing for renters and first-time homebuyers, and protecting water from data centers and mining projects.
She also said she wants to increase the influence of unionized workers and tenants.
